why_best: This approach grounds the subject's credentials directly over live footage without blocking key visual action or cluttering the frame with heavy background shapes.
why_bad: Enclosing the typography in a solid box would obscure the footage and make the talent presentation feel like an overly intrusive broadcast news banner.
trap: A near-miss will let the structural anchor line feel disconnected from the text block, causing the typography to look like it is drifting on top of the live video.
